children: Copper rises in Asian trade. Traders are focusing on the Fed's policy decision due later Wednesday, which could lead to a slight decrease in trading activity, Baocheng Futures analysts say in a note. A Fed rate hike is almost a certainty, potentially resulting in a stronger dollar, they note. A stronger greenback weakens the appeal of dollar-denominated commodities such as copper. The three-month copper futures contract on the London Metal Exchange is up 0.2% at $14,115.50 a metric ton.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
